		if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner.var:zg361_mechanism_201_choice = 2 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_choice value = 2 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner.var:zg361_mechanism_201_choice = 3 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_choice value = 3 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner = { is_ai = yes is_at_war = yes } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_choice value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_x_owner = { is_ai = yes stewardship < 10 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_choice value = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:zg361_ip_m201_choice < 3
			NOT = {
always = yes
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_choice value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m201_prerequisite_deferred value = 1 }

		limit = {

			has_variable = zg361_ip_incident_owner

					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m201_done_case = $TICKET_CASE$ }
					NOT = { var:zg361_ip_m201_done_state = $TICKET_STATE$ }
				}
			}

			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_x_subject

			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$

			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_incident_serial value = var:zg361_ip_incident_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_incident_source_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_source_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_incident_consequence_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_type_code value = 204 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 204 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_consumer_contract value = 204 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7204 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m204_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_x_last_consumer value = 204 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m204_business_object_created = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_severity_fact_used value = var:zg361_ip_m196_corrected_severity }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_budget_remaining value = { value = 100 subtract = var:zg361_ip_m204_reliability_spend max = 0 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_release_frozen value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_ip_m204_budget_remaining <= 60 } set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_release_frozen value = 1 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_consumer_consume_reliability_budget value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m204_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}
}
